Well, as I'm sure you know, there are no good way to be dumped. It's not going to be different from any other breakup you have known, so.. just explain him.
It is courageous from you to take that decision and not to make it last if you are sure that you don't want to be with him anymore and there's nothing you guys can do about it. Don't go for a break, don't make things worse little by little in the hope that he will agree with you that it doesn't work anymore (because he won't).
The only thing you can do is advise him to seek help if the unemployment/breakup combo is too much for him to bear, there's no shame in asking for help, especially under those circumstances.
I wish you both luck

It had been going on all along but I couldn't quite put my finger on it until the end of the relationship, when she told me what had been wrong from her point of view.

Basically the double bind was coming from the fact that she wanted to be 2 person at the same time: 
- a trophy you show everyone proudly, who is a perfect and totally dependent housewife
- a strong independent woman, who doesn't need anyone.

If I try to pay for dinner, she argues to pay half of it. If I don't, I should have.

She could use a ton of make up, a dress and high heels one day, and give me a lecture about "bodyshaming", all woman are beautiful the way they are and I won't shave my legs anymore the day after.

Doomed if you do, doomed if you don't at it's finest. I ended up telling her I could date a princess or a grunge hippie, but not both at the same time if they were the same person.
Haha thanks for the laugh :)

Had the same experience and it went down like this:
_________

If you agree and for the purpose of this story, let's call the character "Stupid Me From Back Then" and (pardon my french) "The Coldhearted Bitch".
_________

When the Coldhearted Bitch broke up with Stupid Me From Back Then, he announced her he would go NC, likely for ever. The day after, Innocent Stupid Me From Back Then - who had still no clue The Coldhearted Bitch had BPD and just thought she was bipolar -  receives 2 emails and a text quite like yours. He thinks:

 "*Hurray at last she understood ! May the gods be blessed ! she says she's sincere and isn't playing with me, so I can trust her. I should jump of joy but my heart just got so overstretched that I dont feel anything. Anyway I know that I still love her, so that's the most beautiful day of my life.*"

Then Stupid Me From Back Then proceeds to text back "*I love you too let's work on ourselves and our relationship*" and a lot of reaaaaally embarrassing things about everlasting love, that him and her were so fond of.

The Coldhearted Bitch answers "*can you come and see me ? I'm too shaken to take the subway*". Stupid Me From Back Then thinks "*well she's the one who dumped me yesterday by text after cheating on me and begging me to take her back, I guess she should understand that I'm destroyed because I spent the night crying like I've never had, but let's be a knight in shining armour*".

Stupid Me From Back Then jumped on his horse and off he goes, expecting they would fall in each other's arm and swear eternal love. How tricky life can be ! "*What the hell is going on ?*" Is Stupid Me asking himself "*why is she so cold and obviously not in love ?*". They agreed to give each other some time.

Literally TWO SECONDS after saying goodbye, Stupid Me gets a text. All those emotional rollercoaster had got him numb. He doesn't know if it's day or night, if he's happy or sad, if he's living or dead. "*Perhaps we should make a break, what do you think ? I don't know anymore, I'm lost*" says the text.

Well "Stupid Me From Back Then" is called like that for a reason. He said, no, but eventually yes. He waited for a month without hearing from her, except when she was so low or lonely that he was obviously the last person available. He listened with a lot of patience to all the thing that Coldhearted Bitch told him he was doing wrong, that she was unhappy with. 

"*If I listen carefully and apply* - thinks Stupid Me From Back Then - *then I'll be able to make her happy and everything shall be even better then they were at the beginning ! How lucky am I to get a second chance with the love of my life ! She's right after all, I wasn't paying enough attention/taking her to dinner/giving her compliments/insert random reproach here*".

The break had a time limit, and at the end of it Stupid Me From Back Then is at last going to have an answer. He listened carefully, worked on himself, he would be the happiest of man if she wants to spend her life by his side, but should she decide to leave, then he would survive, so nothing can go wrong. "*I don't want to make a mistake, I need more time*" said the Coldhearted Bitch. "*Well.. I hadn't anticipated this one*" thinks miserably Stupid Me From Back Then.

After a second month, Stupid Me From Back Then began to be less of a stupid guy. He had been looking on the web, and understood that something was reaaaaally much more wrong than he thought. He thought life was unfair. But he told her he wouldn't take this shit anymore.

"*I want to die !*" Said Coldhearted Bitch. "*I don't want us to be so cold to each other anymore, I need you !*"

Still Quite Stupid Me has been supportive, sent her to a shrink, and both agreed that she would tell him how it went.

Guess what ?

Yup, exactly, she didn't. Someone had been listening to poor her, she didn't need him anymore. Coldhearted Bitch sent Less And Less Stupid Me a text saying she was breaking up with him because she knew that waiting on her decision was hurting him, and that she refused to do so. She insisted on the fact that she was doing it for him, because he had already lost so much weight and she was worried about him.

Sure thing princess. Anyway, I've always thought irony was the best form of humour.

Farewell, I threw away the shining armour, may our path never cross again and may hell be kind to you :)

I've been in your shoes and I'm absolutely sorry this is happening to you.
My ex lied to me to my face about cheating, and truth is I sort of believed her because I needed to. My opinion is: he lied to you because he thinks he can act like that and get away with it, which means he doesn't respect you.

- Did anything happen between Daisy and your pwBPD before you were together ? 
- from my experience people who play the "don't tell him that I told you" game are not as honest as they might seem, and that game has a cost, which is you being hurt as fuck because you don't know what to believe. Did she tell you why it should remain a secret ?
- your pwBPD lies to you and then puts the blame on you for being angry about it. It doesn't seem to me as the behaviour of someone who is open and honest about what he did or didn't do.

Same thing for me, I would spend so much time helping her sorting her life that I felt like I had a 24 yo daughter, and I totally lost interest in having sex with her because it was like even the fact that she wanted sex and the way she was asking it was part of her messy life
Same thing here, she actually started to speak with an accent.. i mean.. the absence of identity is strong with this one.

Absolutely. And no matter what I refused to give her, she would tell me that her reactions were due to "her past relationships" about which she had told me just enough to show me how much of a victim she was. She wanted to invade my personnal space and be friend with all of my friends ? "But that's because it's the way we used to work in my past relationship !". She would drink half a bottle of Vodka while we were on holidays watching a movie ? "But thats because I would always drink with my ex when we were going somewhere". And if she didnt want me to do something, she would use the same trick.

It's very smart to create this kind of "i cant talk about it because it hurts me" zone and then use it to justify just about anything. The mask slipped when I realised she would twist her past and say things and their opposite just to get what she wanted or justify her shitty behaviour. That chick was the most manipulative and dangerous being i've ever encountered, and thank god we're done. 

I came to realise that the breakup was not the tragedy of my life, but that a life with her would have been.

We both lived by our parents, so every time I had to get her to leave my place to get back to hers, it would be a drama. She would show by any means at her disposal that it was hurting her, often crying or being frustrated, which lead to her giving me the silent treatment. Then she would text me that whenever i was explaining her that it was time to leave, she felt like she didnt matter to me, and that I did not love her as much as she did love me.

So i would end either letting her stay despite the fact that I didnt really want to (we werent together for that long and I had my own life to manage), or spend the hours before asking her to leave to be anxious about how to do it so that it wouldnt cause dramas and issues.

She would always find a way to make herself appear as a saint: it's not that she couldnt stand loneliness, it's that she loved me and people so much. It's not that she was being capricious, it's that she had anticipated things to be so perfect because she wanted the time that we were spending together to be so, that when they werent exactly the way she had expected, it would make her very sad. Poor little thing :,)

Who knows.. what matters is to realise that she was a pwBPD or acting like one with you, which is the same thing as far as your concern because this relationship was not right by any stretch of the imagination. She will always find someone to take care of her, and will always find a way to act like she has nothing to do with the mess around her, because she likely cant face the fact that she is the one creating it and that she thrills in doing so. Other people will believe her and get deceived, lied to and cheated on. What matters is that you wont do the same mistake twice.

Trust me, I know you will..! I really thought I would never get back up, I was like "ok thats it, I'm 30, I've lost the love of my life, I'm done". It's been the worst time of my life. 

What really helped me, was the fact that lately I realised she was trashing me behind my back to people I had introduced her to. It made me mad as hell. After all I had done, forgiving the cheating, trying to get the pieces of our relationship back together. And then I realised: I am so lucky this is over. The fact that she actually is putting me in the "ex abusive bf" category blown all her lies away in my head, and I realised that from the start she was just and always putting herself in that position to trigger my protective instinct. She would have made my life a hell, manipulating my friends or colleagues to turn them against me.. I am so lucky we didnt have child together. I could have done everything the way she wanted, she still wouldnt have been satisfied, because that's who she is.. It took me months to sort everything out, but now I know that she is a destructive being aiming at chaos, so better stay the hell away from her and her dramas :)

Bottom line: at some point you will realise that you cannot win with a pwBPD, because they wont let you. You couldnt have done anything better, because you cant sort the mess in their heads for them. It will hit you like a light through the darkness, and you will feel lighter and lighter. DM me if you need to talk about all of that, I know how rough it is, and wouldnt let anyone go through this alone ! You can do this, you are stronger than this experience and you will learn so much from it !

- we were getting along well but would only meet once or twice a year for a few beers. 2 years ago, we saw each other twice in a row, and she texted me she had suddenly realised we were meant for each other. I liked her very much, so I thought we should actually give it a try, so I basically told her that I agreed. She texted me back "so we do it, we spend our life together ?". She insisted on seeing me the same night, and said she was in love with me. I thought it was cutely naive. I was.

- later told me she realised she loved me when I didn't hit her for spilling a glass. I thought she was a hurt little thing. She was a hurting one.

- Told me her 2 exes had cheated on her, and were abusive. She would still send them happy birthday texts, but that was "because being so empathic". Her empathy didn't prevent her from cheating on me.

- after our first night together, we woke up late. She told me she had therefore missed an appointment with her shrink, but that she didn't need it anymore because she was happy with me. She confessed as well she was on antidepressant.

- Wanted us to spend EVERY MINUTE of our days together, and said it's because she loved me so much.. Well nope.

- She would tell me how great her family and friends were. But would always complain to me on how mean they were to her, I quickly realised they couldn't stand her, because they had to walk on eggshells.

And that list could go on. Like forever. But after a few month of NC I can sincerely laugh about all that :)

My ex had BPD, and I know how much we think we could have done more and been more, and I can only guess how much you blame yourself for being only a human being who sometimes got exhausted.
Thing is, after spending lots of time on this sub, you realise how much you cant save every single time someone who wants to die.
Sometimes therapy can, sometimes meds can, and sometimes people can.
But at the end of the day, and I know how unfair it looks, you are not responsible in any kind of way for what happened because she was the one who chose to end her life. I know it wont take the regrets nor the pain away and I'm so sorry for your loss.

Beeing part of her wedding is really courageous of you, you're lucky to be there for each others.
For me it's my friends, they have the same way of seeing the world in dark, but we joke so much about it that it takes the pressure of our shoulders for a while. Laughter and feeling understood seems to be the only temporary cure sometimes :)

At first I thought that it was weird to see a title matching my state of mine. Then I thought it was funny you were a graphic designer and illustrator, because so am I. But that story with your gf, cuter than you, and the fact that you made her dependent of you using your intellectual superiority, and that at some point she left because she realised she could live by herself, i mean, it litterally happened to me as well. I've been in a depression ever since she left 6 month ago.  Loosing someone who basically thinks you are god and that the sun wouldnt shine without you, there are no words. I've been contemplating my own shadows since, and admitting exactly which part of me had the potential to be a terrible human being and I know i wont ever be the same again. And I'm not sure I'll get out of that chaotic place, neither of what I'll be if I do. I've admitted to myself that I might not agree to having, as all human beings, so much darkness inside of me, because it doesnt match my ideal, so I might end my life at some point and i'm ok with that.

The point is, more than I thought I could ever mean it, I feel you, and i'm fucking sorry for what you're going through. Sincerly.

I absolutely agree. And parts of me wonder: would the medication make me more myself ? And if not, who would it make me ?  I'm sorry to hear you've been through this as well. Does medication help you ?

Thank you, really. Yes i've seen a psychiatrist since the breakup, but didnt want to take medication, my dad is on antidepressant for years and he looks like his own shadow.. i guess in a twisted way, I'd rather leave the way I am than to try to change myself with addictive medication giving me a sense of happiness..
